translation.title: Rosario Islands: A Day at San Pedro de Majagua
translation.lead: Travel from Cartagena to Isla Grande for a day at San Pedro de Majagua, with a shared speedboat crossing and a Caribbean lunch.
included: Private transfers between your hotel in Cartagena and the pier.
Return journey on a shared speedboat.
notes: Conditions and pricing for the private boat option are confirmed when booking.

hero.alt: Rosario Islands in the Caribbean Sea, Colombia

translation.body:
Your private transfer takes you from the hotel in Cartagena to the pier. From there, board a shared speedboat to the Rosario archipelago and San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande.

Spend the day relaxing beside the Caribbean Sea. There is time to swim, find a shady spot among the tropical vegetation and unwind away from the city. The programme includes a traditional Caribbean lunch, dessert, coffee or tea, and the marine tax.

In the afternoon, return to Cartagena by shared speedboat. A private transfer then takes you from the pier back to your hotel.

If you wish, you can add a private boat outing at an additional cost, giving you more flexibility with your time on the water.
